reviews.author: Edwin Carreras
reviews.text: Jose from JJ Hook was absolutely the best. I needed a tow from Vineland to AC. The price was excellent and the service was amazing. Customer for life!

reviews.author: Jasmine Powell
reviews.text: I would HIGHLY recommend JJ hook towing services. It was truly an pleasant experience. Thank you so much for helping me in my time of need !!!

reviews.author: Athena Bussie
reviews.text: I was so pleased by J.J. hook services. Truly an angel and disguise. Thank you so much for helping me and my daughter get home safely, god bless!!

reviews.author: Kiera
reviews.text: It’s 4/16/25 Been calling since 7:50pm. No answer and can’t leave a voicemail. It’s now 8:27pm and still just rings.

reviews.author: shakira lee
reviews.text: He was there in a timely manner, very nice he’s a beast reliable and knows what he’s doing I 100 percent recommend!!
